crossRefs.note: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.
For though you wash yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iniquity is marked before me,” says the Lord Yahweh.
The guilt of Ephraim is stored up. His sin is stored up.
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…
The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one…

translations.web: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
translations.bsb: “Have I not stored up these things, sealed up within My vaults?
translations.kjv: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
translations.asv: Is not this laid up in store with me, Sealed up among my treasures?
